pronunciation_schema.policy: Do not invent IPA, Bengali phonetic spellings, syllable boundaries, stress, or audio. Populate only from a traceable German-language source and keep generated device TTS distinct from native recordings.

fields.ipa: Optional IPA transcription from a checked German pronunciation source.
fields.bengali_pronunciation: Optional learner-friendly Bengali approximation; never a substitute for IPA or audio.
fields.syllables: Optional syllable segmentation verified against the German pronunciation.
fields.stress_syllable: Optional 1-based index of the stressed syllable.
fields.audio_sources: Optional array of source URL, source name, language tag, and recording type (native_recording or generated_tts).
fields.pronunciation_status: Use missing, source_found, source_checked, or independently_verified.

pronunciation_schema.audio_language_requirement: de or de-* only. Never use an English voice as a German pronunciation fallback.
